category: Identify and Confirm Vulnerabilities on an Ongoing Basis (RV)
subcategory_text: Identify vulnerabilities continuously using automated scanning, advisories, threat-intelligence feeds, and bug-bounty or external-research inputs.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-2, SI-5, PM-15
implementation_examples: Run scheduled SCA scans of all production dependencies
Subscribe to NVD, GHSA, vendor advisories, and OS package feeds
Operate a bug-bounty programme for customer-facing surfaces
assessment_objectives: Determine whether vulnerability identification is continuous and automated.
Determine whether external reports are tracked and acknowledged.
